definitions.gloss: to bow; to lower one's head
definitions.explanation: The physical act of bowing — lowering one's head as a gesture of greeting, respect, or gratitude.

definitions.gloss: to apologize humbly; to beg; to ask a favor
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to humble oneself before someone, typically to apologize, make a request, or show deference.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}く{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げた。
{先生|せんせい}に{会|あ}ったら{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げなさい。
examples.english: Bow when you see your teacher.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{努力|どりょく}には{頭|あたま}が{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: I take my hat off to his effort.

examples.japanese: {客|きゃく}に{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げて{謝|あやま}った。
examples.english: I bowed to the customer and apologized.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げて{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んだ。
{上司|じょうし}に{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げてでも{許可|きょか}をもらわなければならない。
examples.english: I have to humble myself before my boss to get permission, even if it means begging.

notes:
A fundamental expression in Japanese culture where bowing carries deep social meaning. The physical act and the figurative meaning of humbling oneself are closely linked.

RELATED WORDS:
- {頭|あたま}が{下|さ}がる: to feel admiration/respect (intransitive — involuntary feeling)
- {頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げる: to bow/humble oneself (transitive — deliberate action)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深|ふか}く{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げる: to bow deeply
- {何度|なんど}も{頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げる: to bow repeatedly
- {頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げて{頼|たの}む: to bow and make a request
- {頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げて{謝|あやま}る: to bow and apologize

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{辞儀|じぎ}する: to bow — the standard neutral word for bowing
- {平身低頭|へいしんていとう}する: to prostrate oneself — extreme humility; very formal
- {腰|こし}を{低|ひく}くする: to lower one's stance — figuratively, to be humble in dealings
